title: 极简风格插画
prompt: Create a minimalistic illustration of [object or scene] in a paper cut-out style. Use soft, pastel colors and simple shapes. Include layered paper textures and subtle shadows to create depth. Place the object on a plain background. Ensure a clean, modern, and aesthetically pleasing composition with a slightly isometric perspective.
description: Nano Banana Pro 助您创作极简风格插画，采用柔和粉彩与分层纸张纹理，轻松打造现代品牌设计和清新景观艺术。Nano Banana Pro 模型以剪纸风格和等距视角，呈现简洁美观的构图，适合编辑设计和深度视觉表达。
